remarks: Sophisticated one-level living awaits in this beautifully renovated three bedrooms,three full bathrooms coveted end unit in the desirable Leefair community. The sunny interior features an open, thoughtfully designed floor plan with a generous living room with fireplace flanked by book shelves which is open to the dining room with its French doors to the outdoors, a sleek updated eat-in kitchen, a spacious primary ensuite, another bedroom and an open family room. Plantation shutters add a touch of elegance throughout. The lower level has a large office, second family room, third large bedroom and a full bath, along with your laundry. There's an attached two car garage, too. From the dining room French doors, step outside to your own fenced and private patio~just perfect for outdoor dining, entertaining and relaxing in a peaceful setting. The gate allows access to a path for your walk into the heart of downtown New Canaan and the Metro North station.  This exceptional turnkey home combines timelessness, along with modern comfort in one of the town's most desirable condo enclaves.
